description: Black Forest Labs' nvfp4 packaging: the same element type and the same tensor names as `cozy.nvfp4-flat`, and NOT the same bytes. Two differences, both invisible to every check that looks at names, dtypes and ranks: the packed pair is HIGH-nibble (element 2j in the HIGH nibble), and the block scales are stored PRE-SWIZZLED in the cuBLAS 2-D tiled layout rather than flat row-major — so the scale tensor is a 1-D array of ceil(out/128)*128*ceil(in/16/4)*4 e4m3 values, not an [out, in/16] matrix. Reading one format as the other measured LPIPS 1.11. These two rules exist as two digests for exactly that reason; do not merge them, do not alias them, and do not 'normalise' either one's conventions into the other's.
name: bfl.nvfp4-preswizzled
